text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
The wreckage from the last test flight? I
haven't retrieved it because
I've no means
to do so.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
You need a specialized truck to move it.
My teacher had one he designed himself,
but... Well,
that plane was the last straw. He retired
after the flight failed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You didn't ask him to at least retrieve
the
airplane?

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't—I thought it'd be asking too
much. That airplane... It was designed to
my specifications,
so the failure was all on
me.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
It's all my fault... I'm the one who drove
him to retirement...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So that's why the current model doesn't
reflect data from the old
prototype.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide! Taishin! Welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I read through the research notes
in between job requests. As
such, I have a
pretty good grasp of the current
situation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If we want our research to progress,
there's no better data set than
what we can glean from the actual model.
Let's get that truck and
bring the wreck in.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm the one who robbed my teacher
of his dreams. I can't take
yet another
thing he put his heart and soul into
and...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's an excuse, and you know it. In
reality, you're afraid to look at
that
airplane.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You want to run, to turn your face away
from your failure!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're wrong! I'm thinking of my teacher...

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
My blunder was so huge that he didn't
even return to the workshop! What makes
you think he'd want to look at the biggest
mistake he's
ever made?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is that truly what you think?
Then it's all the more vital that you look
back on your
teacher's notes and know the truth!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what's gotten into you, Hayahide?!
You're being really harsh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Hayahide.
...That goes for you
too.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Right... My apologies.
I got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As did I. I'm sorry. I'll go and cool my
head...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait!
Sorry! I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Her teacher retiring is part of the reason
she refuses to face up to her
past mistake.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But she ought to know better than anyone
that her teacher's legacy is
stamped
indelibly on that airplane...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was there in those research notes—all
the countless hours of effort.
I could feel it
just reading the pages, so I imagine she'd
know better than I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You did read those notes cover to cover. It seemed like you found useful hints in there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Those notes are the result of
years of effort. I wanted to
ensure that all
that hard work didn't go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
He confronted his mistakes by addressing
them one by one. No matter how many
obstacles he faced, he kept recalculating
his
winning formula!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And while there were still mistakes,
he was
getting closer each time!
He was getting
positive results!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whether he succeeded or not, the proof of
his dedication remains. Failure is but a
stepping stone to the heights of success!
It's part of
this project's history!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think her teacher's findings should be
integrated into the next test
model. If she
won't do it,
then we'll do it in her stead.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet with her teacher, borrow his
truck, and bring that plane
back to the
workshop!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait. Isn't he retired, though? And our
friend's been going out of her
way to avoid
him.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What if he really is trying to forget the
past? Shouldn't we leave him
alone?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want to remember races I lost
either, so I focus on winning
the next one.
I'd rather paint over bitter defeat with
victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No,
I think there's value in looking back
to the past. Your efforts are not in
vain—that applies to invention as well as
racing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's all about building on the things
you've
learned from your
experiences. There are
lessons to be learned from failure too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I guess that's your truth, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, why don't we start by talking
to this teacher? We've just
got to know
how to approach him, is all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
At this rate,
even if the next test succeeds,
our friend won't truly be
happy, right?
That's why I want to find him too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I totally agree! We won't know how he
feels until we actually meet
him!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, ummm... I wanna see the plane fly!
And we need the old one to
do that,
right? So yeah, count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Fine. I'm in too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All righty,
let's head to his house... Wait.
Where does he even live?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I know! He's working as a steam
engine... repair guy? He's at the
station!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How do you know that, Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I talked with a bunch of people about the
airplane while I was out
making deliveries.
They told me where he works!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Way to go! Now we know where to find
him!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'll take you guys straight to him!
Follow me!
